title: Make both copies of the historical superseded lane record truthful and terminal, releasing the self file-scope block that aborted dispatch Phase 0

sha_binding.verified_source_note: The last non-proof commit on this branch; it carries the entire functional change. It is the anchor only because a file cannot contain its own SHA. merge_sha is explicitly null pre-merge rather than a branch SHA or a stand-in token, and is set by post-merge rebinding.

premise_check.claim: Both historical copies hold a dispatch slot and a 54-path file_scope_lock solely because their status `blocked` is a member of ACTIVE_LOCK_STATUSES. Moving both to `superseded`, a non-success terminal status outside that set, releases the capacity and the lock, removes the only repository-wide `block` condition, and removes both records from the scheduled reconciler's selection.
premise_check.method: Read ACTIVE_LOCK_STATUSES and the transition table in scripts/ops/shared.ts. Applied the transition to the root record with the canonical `ops:lane-manifest update` command to confirm it is accepted rather than asserting legality from the table. Executed ops:merge-risk, ops:execution-state, ops:reconcile, ops:substrate-guard and ops:orchestration-reconcile on this branch and, as a negative control, on the unmodified control checkout at the same base.
premise_check.result: Confirmed on every tool. See negative_control and positive_observation.

why_the_prior_correction_did_not_hold.root_cause: The defect UTV2-1756 fixed: writeManifest always resolved to the root path, so reading the still-blocked parked copy overwrote the root record.
why_the_prior_correction_did_not_hold.consequence_for_this_lane: With that fix on main each copy is written to its own path — visible in the negative control as two separate planned mutations. Correcting one copy alone would leave the other selected and re-asserting an active lane. Both are corrected here.

sync_file_disposition.method: Grepped every orchestration consumer for directory enumeration of .ops/sync. substrate-guard.ts, reconcile.ts, execution-state.ts and merge-risk.ts contain zero references. sync-check.mjs resolves exactly one path from the current branch's issue ID. lane-start.ts, file-scope-guard.ts and proof-schema.ts use per-issue paths for the lane being processed. housekeeping-fast-ci.yml iterates the directory but only warns on YAML well-formedness.
sync_file_disposition.conclusion: Its presence was NOT keeping orchestration authority alive, and its removal is not what clears any condition above. Removed because it is stale per-issue coordination state for a terminal record and because removal is the canonical terminal action: lane-close.ts deletes exactly .ops/sync/<issue>.yml at terminal state. The negative authority result is reported rather than omitted so the removal is not credited with an effect it did not have.

proof_format_gates.note: The proof format gates disagree on their contracts, and passing one does not imply passing the others. proof-auditor-gate requires '## Summary'/'## Evidence'/'## Verification'; the close-eligibility preflight (CEP-E3) requires the literal tokens '# PROOF:', 'MERGE_SHA:', 'ASSERTIONS:', 'EVIDENCE:'; CEP-E5 requires a line matching ^\s*MERGE_SHA: or ^\s*Merge SHA: in EVERY markdown artifact; proof-rebind additionally requires exactly one such line plus a '## Merge SHA Binding' heading per file it rebinds.
proof_format_gates.first_submission_defect: The first pushed revision wrote the anchor as '**Merge SHA:** `<sha>`'. The leading '**' defeats the ^\s*Merge SHA: anchor regex, so CEP-E5 reported both markdown artifacts as unbindable: post-merge rebinding would have been impossible and the lane would have been strandable. proof-auditor-gate passed on that same revision, locally and in CI. Corrected to a bare 'MERGE_SHA: <sha>' line in both artifacts, each paired with a '## Merge SHA Binding' section.
proof_format_gates.verification_method: The close-eligibility evaluator (evaluateCloseEligibilityPreflight) was executed locally against this bundle with the same inputs the workflow supplies, rather than inferred from the CI log.

known_gaps: No Codex CLI invocation occurred. The lane is registered executor codex with profile codex-sol-high, but the authorized change is a bounded mechanical state correction with no authored code, so it was performed directly. The model-routing sidecar omits codex_exit_code and codex_cli_version rather than asserting a run that did not happen. Re-registering the lane as Claude-executed is a PM call.

The two historical copies remain duplicated. This lane makes both truthful and terminal; it does not deduplicate them, and does not change the rule that a parked copy and a root copy sharing an issue_id are read as two lanes. That duplication is the mechanism that produced the self-overlap, and it is still the shape of the substrate for every other parked record.

The reconciler's stranded rule still does not converge for any record it selects: it preserves heartbeat_at, so it re-fires every six hours and appends another identical receipt. This lane removes two records from that rule's selection; it does not fix the rule.
ops:orchestration-reconcile still exits 3 from three transient Linear lookup timeouts, unrelated to this lane.

sign_off.note: This bundle is evidence, not certification. The done-gate is ops:truth-check and merge authority is the merge gate's.
